00105 void TSpawnUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00106 {
00107     if(shouldStopAllEvents() == true) initEvents();
00108     
00109     if(reachedMaxRepeats() == true)
00110     {
00111         SpawnBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00112     }
00113     else
00114     {
00115         const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();    
00116         int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;    
00117         int startSample = 0;
00118         int numSamples = 0;
00119         
00120         const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00121         
00122         float* trigSamples = inputs[Trig].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00123         
00124         while(numSamplesToProcess)
00125         {
00126             float currentTrig = *trigSamples++;
00127                         
00128             if(lastTrig <= 0.f && currentTrig > 0.f)
00129             {
00130                 if(numSamples > 0)
00131                 {
00132                     // render samples from startSample to startSample+numSample
00133                     UGen::setBlockSize(numSamples);
00134                     
00135                     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00136                     {
00137                         bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData() + startSample;
00138                     }
00139                     
00140                     mixer.prepareForBlock(numSamples, blockID + startSample);
00141                     mixer.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamples, numChannels);
00142                     mixer.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID + startSample, -1);
00143                 }
00144                 
00145                 startSample += numSamples;
00146                 numSamples = 1;
00147                 
00148                 // add the new voice and re init the mixer
00149                 UGen newVoice = spawnEvent(*this, currentEventIndex++);
00150                 events <<= newVoice;
00151                 mixer = Mix(&events, false);
00152             }
00153             else
00154             {
00155                 ++numSamples;
00156             }
00157             
00158             lastTrig = currentTrig; 
00159             --numSamplesToProcess;
00160         }
00161         
00162         UGen::setBlockSize(numSamples);
00163         
00164         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00165         {
00166             bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData() + startSample;
00167         }
00168         
00169         mixer.prepareForBlock(numSamples, blockID + startSample);
00170         mixer.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamples, numChannels);
00171         mixer.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID + startSample, -1);
00172         
00173         UGen::setBlockSize(blockSize);
00174     }
00175 }

00178 void TSpawnUGenInternal::trigger(void* extraArgs) throw()
00179 {
00180     if(reachedMaxRepeats() == false)
00181     {
00182         UGen newVoice = spawnEvent(*this, currentEventIndex++, extraArgs);
00183         events <<= newVoice;
00184     }
00185 }
